verdicts.reason: Both break up the original's tight block (rule, headline, subhead, rule) and scatter the pieces down the whole canvas: the rules sit at the very top and bottom edges, and 'food & drinks' floats about 340px below the headline with dead space in between. The packaging photo is also cropped to fragments along the right edge. A's 'Order online' is far too small for a hero headline but is at least still bolder and a little bigger than the subhead. B shrinks the headline even further until it is smaller than 'food & drinks', which flips the hierarchy and leaves the main message close to unreadable.
